clearSpace.rule: Minimum clear space equals the height of one monogram figure on all sides

prohibited: Do not change individual colors of the monogram figures
Do not separate monogram from wordmark in the full logo variant
Do not add effects (shadows, gradients, outlines) to the logo
Do not stretch or skew — always scale proportionally
Do not rearrange the figure positions in the monogram
Do not use the logo at less than minimum size

colorVariants.reversed: White monogram + white text — use on dark/brand-color backgrounds
colorVariants.monochrome: All black or all white — for single-color print, embossing, watermarks

construction.monogram: 3 overlapping stylized human figures in pink (#F386A1), green (#83C994), and sky blue (#4FC6E0) with magenta (#E33D8A) and teal (#00A4C4) at overlap intersections. All paths are vector.
construction.wordmark: 'CareSmartz' in brand blue (#1C83C6) + '360' in dark gray (#232323). Tagline 'A BETTER WAY TO CARE' in medium gray (#808285) below.
construction.ring: White rectangle background behind compact variant (504x160px) for clearspace protection.
